categories.main_business_segments: China Post Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent logistics systems and intelligent special vehicles. Its main products include intelligent sorting systems, intelligent transmission systems, and intelligent special vehicles, serving industries such as express logistics, e-commerce, automotive, and airports.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI-based high-precision mixed parcel separation, dynamic algorithm-based high-speed control, servo-driven high-speed wheel control, AI-powered visual recognition, and robotics guidance. It employs integrated product development (IPD) and digital twin technologies for product design and manufacturing, focusing on automation, digitalization, and intelligent logistics solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major express logistics companies such as China Post, SF Express, JD.com, Huawei, and emerging e-commerce platforms like ByteDance, Xiyin, and Pinduoduo. The company serves domestic and international markets, including Japan, Southeast Asia, and Europe, focusing on logistics, e-commerce, automotive, and airport sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic market presence. It also actively expands international markets, securing large orders from Japan and developing business in Southeast Asia and Europe. Its headquarters and main R&D centers are located in Shanghai, Beijing, Guangdong, and Hubei.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Post Technology operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain as a manufacturer and integrator of intelligent logistics equipment and systems. It designs, produces, and installs automated sorting and transmission systems and intelligent vehicles, providing end-to-end solutions for logistics operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing core competitiveness through technological innovation, emphasizing AI, big data, cloud computing, edge computing, digital twin, and robotics. It prioritizes R&D in intelligent sorting platforms, unmanned vehicle control, and automated loading/unloading technologies, while expanding digital management and international market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of intelligent logistics systems and special vehicles, supplemented by sales of spare parts and technical services. The company uses direct sales domestically and a combination of direct contracts and authorized agents internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Post Technology is a leading domestic player in intelligent logistics equipment manufacturing with a strong market position supported by its technological innovation and extensive project experience. It competes in a highly competitive industry with other intelligent logistics system providers, leveraging its early market entry and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 912 million, a 53.26% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to economic fluctuations and delayed customer investments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 147.86 million, reflecting intensified market competition and reduced project margins. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.74 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 9.89% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Post Technology emphasizes high-precision, high-speed, and intelligent automation solutions tailored to diverse logistics scenarios. Its products integrate AI-driven visual recognition, dynamic control algorithms, and modular design to improve sorting efficiency and adaptability. The company also focuses on reducing operational costs and enhancing system reliability, supported by comprehensive after-sales services and digital management platforms.
